role.en: Founder & CEO, World Labs; Co-Director, Stanford HAI
role.zh: World Labs 创始人兼 CEO；斯坦福以人为本 AI 研究院共同院长

why.en: Created ImageNet and set off the deep-learning revolution. Now argues that language models have no native model of geometry, persistence, occlusion or gravity — and is building the spatial layer that grounds AI in the physical world.
why.zh: 创造了 ImageNet，直接引发深度学习革命。她现在主张语言模型对几何、持久性、遮挡与重力没有原生表征 —— 并正在构建把 AI 锚定于物理世界的空间层。

title.en: From Words to Worlds: Spatial Intelligence is AI's Next Frontier
title.zh: 从词语到世界：空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿

note.en: A ~10,000-word essay: today's LLMs are 'eloquent but ungrounded'. Spatial intelligence — linking imagination, perception and action — is the next step.
note.zh: 约一万字长文：今天的大模型「雄辩却无根」。空间智能 —— 连接想象、感知与行动 —— 是下一步。

title.en: Spatial Intelligence Is AI's Next Frontier
title.zh: 空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿

title.en: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
title.zh: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer

note.en: Co-authored with Stanford's Jiajun Wu, RoboRender generates robot-oriented synthetic video to close the sim-to-real visual gap for policy transfer, in line with her spatial-AI research at World Labs.
note.zh: 与斯坦福大学吴佳俊合作撰写的RoboRender论文，通过生成面向机器人的合成视频来缩小仿真与现实之间的视觉差距以提升策略迁移效果，与她在World Labs从事的空间智能研究方向一致。

title.en: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
title.zh: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions

note.en: Paper introducing a latent-action-conditioned robot world model that generalizes across different robot embodiments, co-authored with longtime Stanford collaborator Jiajun Wu.
note.zh: 论文提出一种基于潜在动作条件的机器人世界模型，可在不同机器人形态间泛化，由李飞飞与斯坦福长期合作者吴佳俊等共同完成。

title.en: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models
title.zh: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models

note.en: Li co-authored OpenWAM, an open framework for composable world-action models that couple future prediction with robot control.
note.zh: 李飞飞合著了OpenWAM，这是一个开放框架，用于构建将未来预测与机器人控制相结合的可组合世界-动作模型。

title.en: LoGo: Local-Global Rewards for Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation
title.zh: LoGo: Local-Global Rewards for Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation

note.en: Li co-authored LoGo, a method using local-global rewards to fix 3D inconsistency in long-horizon, camera-controlled video generation.
note.zh: 李飞飞共同撰写了LoGo论文，提出用局部-全局奖励方法解决长时程、可控摄像机视频生成中的3D不一致问题。

title.en: T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics
title.zh: T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics

note.en: Fei-Fei Li co-authored a paper with longtime collaborator Jiajun Wu on test-time memory for robotic manipulation, letting policies retain and reuse information no longer visible in the current observation.
note.zh: 李飞飞与长期合作者吴佳俊合著论文，提出面向机器人操作的测试时记忆方法，让策略能够保留并复用当前观测中已不可见的信息。

title.en: To Seek a Newer World
title.zh: To Seek a Newer World

note.en: Fei-Fei Li's own account of why World Labs is joining AMD, framing the acquisition as a way to bring spatial intelligence closer to hardware at scale.
note.zh: 李飞飞亲自撰文说明World Labs加入AMD的原因，将此次收购视为让空间智能更贴近硬件、实现规模化的途径。

title.en: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
title.zh: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library

note.en: Paper with longtime collaborators Jiajun Wu and Huang Huang proposing an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework with a self-evolving tool library for dexterous manipulation learned from human video.
note.zh: 与长期合作者吴佳俊、黄欢等人合著的论文，提出了一个具有自我进化工具库的Agentic Human2Sim2Robot框架，用于从人类视频中学习灵巧操作。

title.en: AMD’s Lisa Su, Fei-Fei Li Discuss $8.2 Billion World Labs Deal
title.zh: AMD’s Lisa Su, Fei-Fei Li Discuss $8.2 Billion World Labs Deal

note.en: Fei-Fei Li joined AMD CEO Lisa Su on Bloomberg Talks to discuss AMD's $8.2 billion acquisition of her company, World Labs.
note.zh: 李飞飞与AMD首席执行官苏姿丰在彭博社节目中谈及AMD以82亿美元收购她创立的World Labs一事。

title.en: Best of: The future of the innovation economy
title.zh: Best of: The future of the innovation economy

note.en: A WSJ "Future of Everything" rerun of a live interview with Fei-Fei Li on the innovation economy.
note.zh: 《华尔街日报》Future of Everything播客重播了与李飞飞就创新经济展开的现场对谈。

title.en: AI Pioneer Fei-Fei Li Talks AI Safety, Competition with China
title.zh: AI Pioneer Fei-Fei Li Talks AI Safety, Competition with China

note.en: Fei-Fei Li is interviewed by Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow on AI safety and competition with China.
note.zh: 李飞飞接受彭博社Ed Ludlow采访，谈AI安全与中美竞争。

title.en: The goal of building any technology, AI included, should be bettering human lives and society.
title.zh: The goal of building any technology, AI included, should be bettering human lives and society.

note.en: Fei-Fei Li states that the goal of any technology, including AI, should be bettering human lives and society — a recurring theme in her human-centered AI advocacy.
note.zh: 李飞飞表示，包括AI在内的任何技术的目标都应是改善人类生活与社会——这是她一贯倡导的以人为本AI理念的延续。

title.en: Agents can be AI, but agency is human. It is every individual’s responsibility to empower our own agency, with the help of tools. But the North Star should alwa
title.zh: Agents can be AI, but agency is human. It is every individual’s responsibility to empower our own agency, with the help of tools. But the North Star should alwa

note.en: Li argued that agency belongs to humans, not AI, and that tools should keep people at the center — a restatement of her human-centered AI thesis.
note.zh: 李飞飞主张能动性应属于人类而非AI，工具应始终以人为中心，这是她一贯的“以人为本”AI理念的再次表达。

title.en: Fei-Fei Li: The Godmother of AI and the Race to Build World Models
title.zh: Fei-Fei Li: The Godmother of AI and the Race to Build World Models

note.en: Profiled and interviewed on the Moconomy Originals podcast about her shift from computer vision to building world models.
note.zh: 在Moconomy Originals播客接受专访，谈及她从计算机视觉转向构建世界模型的历程。

title.en: #715.a16z x 李飞飞：新视角预测通向空间智能
title.zh: #715.a16z x 李飞飞：新视角预测通向空间智能

note.en: Fei-Fei Li joined World Labs co-founders Justin and Ben on a16z's podcast with host Martin Casado to explain the spatial intelligence behind their new world model, Atlas.
note.zh: 李飞飞与World Labs联合创始人Justin、Ben一同做客a16z播客，与主持人Martin Casado探讨其新发布的世界模型Atlas背后的空间智能理念。

title.en: The world of R&D is forking into two paths: the token-abundant research, and the token-starved research. The future is in the former - evidentially, the progres
title.zh: The world of R&D is forking into two paths: the token-abundant research, and the token-starved research. The future is in the former - evidentially, the progres

note.en: Argues AI R&D is forking into token-abundant and token-starved paths, with the token-abundant side pulling ahead — a stance on how compute access is now reshaping research itself.
note.zh: 她指出AI研发正分化为“token充裕”与“token匮乏”两条路径，前者正在领先——这是对算力获取如何重塑研究本身的判断。

title.en: Atlas runs on real-time!!🚀
title.zh: Atlas runs on real-time!!🚀

note.en: Li announced that Atlas, World Labs' spatial-intelligence model, now runs in real time.
note.zh: 李飞飞宣布World Labs的空间智能模型Atlas现已实现实时运行。

title.en: Next view prediction is the key to Atlas, enabling us to unify pixel-level generation and reconstruction. @jcjohnss @BenMildenhall @martin_casado and I had a de
title.zh: Next view prediction is the key to Atlas, enabling us to unify pixel-level generation and reconstruction. @jcjohnss @BenMildenhall @martin_casado and I had a de

note.en: Li explained that next-view prediction is the key mechanism behind World Labs' Atlas model, unifying pixel-level generation and 3D reconstruction.
note.zh: 李飞飞解释称，下一视角预测是World Labs的Atlas模型的核心机制，将像素级生成与三维重建统一了起来。

title.en: Fei Fei Li: The Race to Build World Models For AI
title.zh: Fei Fei Li: The Race to Build World Models For AI

note.en: Li and World Labs co-founders Justin Johnson and Ben Mildenhall discuss their new Atlas world model with a16z's Martin Casado.
note.zh: 李飞飞与World Labs联合创始人Justin Johnson、Ben Mildenhall一起，与a16z的Martin Casado探讨了他们新发布的Atlas世界模型。

title.en: I'm so excited that our @theworldlabs team has achieved a major milestone today! Introducing Atlas - a first of its kind multimodal world model trained from scr
title.zh: I'm so excited that our @theworldlabs team has achieved a major milestone today! Introducing Atlas - a first of its kind multimodal world model trained from scr

note.en: Fei-Fei Li announced Atlas, World Labs' first multimodal world model trained from scratch to perceive, generate, reason about and interact with 3D environments.
note.zh: 李飞飞宣布推出Atlas，这是World Labs首个从零开始训练的多模态世界模型，能够感知、生成、推理并与三维环境互动。

title.en: One Demonstration, Many Objects: Generalizing Manipulation via Local Contact Geometry
title.zh: One Demonstration, Many Objects: Generalizing Manipulation via Local Contact Geometry

note.en: A Stanford robotics paper co-authored with Jiajun Wu, Dorsa Sadigh and Jeannette Bohg proposes generalizing robot manipulation from a single demonstration using local contact geometry.
note.zh: 李飞飞与斯坦福同事吴佳俊、Dorsa Sadigh、Jeannette Bohg合著的论文，提出利用局部接触几何从单次演示中泛化机器人操控能力。

title.en: TrAct: Bridging Robot Control and Visual Prediction with Visual Tracks
title.zh: TrAct: Bridging Robot Control and Visual Prediction with Visual Tracks

note.en: Stanford paper, with her long-time collaborator Jiajun Wu, proposing TrAct: conditioning robot world models on embodiment-agnostic visual tracks rather than raw actions, so control and visual prediction align.
note.zh: 与长期合作者吴佳俊等人合著的斯坦福论文，提出 TrAct：以与机器人本体无关的视觉轨迹（而非原始动作）作为世界模型的条件信号，使控制与视觉预测对齐。

title.en: On this random Sunday afternoon, I just noticed that I have 1M followers on X now. Feels like a big responsibility 🤔❤️
title.zh: On this random Sunday afternoon, I just noticed that I have 1M followers on X now. Feels like a big responsibility 🤔❤️

note.en: Li marked passing 1 million followers on X, reflecting on the responsibility that comes with the reach.
note.zh: 李飞飞在X上分享粉丝数突破100万的感想，并谈到这份影响力带来的责任感。

title.en: Godmother of AI: The Missing Piece of Intelligence LLMs Can't See | Fei-Fei Li
title.zh: Godmother of AI: The Missing Piece of Intelligence LLMs Can't See | Fei-Fei Li

posts.source: Silicon Valley Girl: AI, Tech and Care…

note.en: An interview in which she sets out why language models have no native grasp of space, and the four spatial abilities World Labs is building to supply it.
note.zh: 一场专访，她阐述了语言模型为何天生缺乏空间理解能力，以及 World Labs 正在构建的四项空间能力。

title.en: Using AI to Increase Your Intelligence & Enrich Humanity | Dr. Fei-Fei Li
title.zh: Using AI to Increase Your Intelligence & Enrich Humanity | Dr. Fei-Fei Li

note.en: Huberman Lab interview on how AI can extend human capability, and on the limits of systems with no grounding in the physical world.
note.zh: 在 Huberman Lab 的访谈，谈人工智能如何扩展人的能力，以及缺乏物理世界基础的系统有何局限。

title.en: #667.李飞飞：利用人工智能提升你的智力与丰富人性
title.zh: #667.李飞飞：利用人工智能提升你的智力与丰富人性

note.en: Chinese-dubbed rebroadcast of her Huberman Lab interview, where she discusses using AI to expand human intelligence while staying grounded in humanity.
note.zh: 她在Huberman Lab播客访谈的中文配音转播，讨论如何借助人工智能提升人类智力，同时不失人性。

title.en: Fei-Fei Li on Spatial Intelligence and Robotics
title.zh: Fei-Fei Li on Spatial Intelligence and Robotics

note.en: She discusses spatial intelligence and robotics following World Labs' acquisition of SceniX.
note.zh: 在 World Labs 收购 SceniX 之后，她在节目中谈空间智能与机器人技术。

title.en: When SceniX joined World Labs, we said spatial intelligence was never only about perceiving and generating virtual and physical worlds, but also interacting wit
title.zh: When SceniX joined World Labs, we said spatial intelligence was never only about perceiving and generating virtual and physical worlds, but also interacting wit

note.en: Li shared early results from SceniX's integration into World Labs, following up on the earlier acquisition announcement.
note.zh: 李飞飞公布了SceniX并入World Labs后的初步成果，是此前收购消息的后续进展。

title.en: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling
title.zh: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling

note.en: Paper on unified world modeling that represents actions as masked visual signals so video models can be used as robotic world models.
note.zh: 论文提出用“掩码视觉动作”统一世界模型，让视频模型可以直接充当机器人的世界模型。

title.en: The world is not just made of words, and spatial intelligence was never just about perceiving and generating worlds. It's about interacting with them. Today, Sc
title.zh: The world is not just made of words, and spatial intelligence was never just about perceiving and generating worlds. It's about interacting with them. Today, Sc

note.en: Li announced that SceniX is joining World Labs, framing spatial intelligence as being about interacting with worlds, not just perceiving them.
note.zh: 李飞飞宣布SceniX并入World Labs，并阐述空间智能不仅是感知世界，更是与世界互动。

title.en: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
title.zh: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies

note.en: Introduces RoboTTT, a test-time-training recipe that lets robot policies use much longer visuomotor context than single-step history.
note.zh: 提出 RoboTTT，用测试时训练让机器人策略能利用远长于单步历史的视觉运动上下文。

title.en: 1/N Long horizon, complex tasks that truly matter in everyday life are not solved problems by today’s robotics, requiring planning, object detection, object man
title.zh: 1/N Long horizon, complex tasks that truly matter in everyday life are not solved problems by today’s robotics, requiring planning, object detection, object man

note.en: Li laid out why long-horizon, complex everyday tasks remain unsolved for today's robotics, covering planning, object detection and manipulation.
note.zh: 李飞飞阐述了当前机器人技术在长时程、复杂日常任务上仍未解决的难题，涉及规划、物体检测与操作等方面。

title.en: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
title.zh: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation

note.en: Presents SimFoundry, a system that builds simulation scenes automatically from real scans for training and evaluating robot policies.
note.zh: 提出 SimFoundry，可从真实扫描自动构建仿真场景，用于机器人策略的训练与评测。

title.en: Fei-Fei Li: In 10 Years There Will Be Only 2 Kinds of Workers
title.zh: Fei-Fei Li: In 10 Years There Will Be Only 2 Kinds of Workers

posts.source: Silicon Valley Girl: AI, Tech and Care…

note.en: Interview on how AI will reshape work, and on the $1B raise funding World Labs' push into spatial understanding.
note.zh: 访谈中谈人工智能将如何重塑工作，以及支撑 World Labs 进军空间理解的 10 亿美元融资。

title.en: Your thoughtful reflection is so inspiring and encouraging @smallfly ! As everyone talks about AI and automation, human creativity, story telling and productivi
title.zh: Your thoughtful reflection is so inspiring and encouraging @smallfly ! As everyone talks about AI and automation, human creativity, story telling and productivi

note.en: Li argued that amid the AI and automation conversation, human creativity and storytelling remain essential.
note.zh: 李飞飞指出，在AI与自动化的讨论热潮中，人类的创造力与叙事能力依然至关重要。

title.en: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
title.zh: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation

note.en: Adds tactile reactivity to vision-language-action models so manipulation policies can respond to contact signals in real time.
note.zh: 为视觉-语言-动作模型加入触觉反馈，使操作策略能实时响应接触信号。

title.en: Scientific research is fundamental to advancing civilization and helping people globally to solve the most critical problems, from medicine to materials, from b
title.zh: Scientific research is fundamental to advancing civilization and helping people globally to solve the most critical problems, from medicine to materials, from b

note.en: Li called scientific research fundamental to solving humanity's biggest problems, from medicine to materials to brain science.
note.zh: 李飞飞表示科学研究是解决人类重大问题（从医学、材料到脑科学）的根本所在。

title.en: A Functional Taxonomy of World Models
title.zh: A Functional Taxonomy of World Models

note.en: Her essay sorting world models into renderers, simulators and planners, and describing the loop that connects them.
note.zh: 她撰文将世界模型划分为渲染器、模拟器与规划器三类，并阐述连接三者的闭环。

title.en: Planning with the Views
title.zh: Planning with the Views

note.en: Tests whether vision-language models can predict how a camera move changes the view and plan several moves ahead, a direct probe of spatial reasoning.
note.zh: 考察视觉语言模型能否预测相机移动后的视角变化并做多步规划，直接检验空间推理能力。

title.en: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop
title.zh: ESI-Bench: Towards Embodied Spatial Intelligence that Closes the Perception-Action Loop

note.en: ESI-Bench evaluates embodied spatial intelligence over the full perception-action loop rather than passive perception alone.
note.zh: ESI-Bench 以完整的感知-行动闭环来评测具身空间智能，而非只考察被动感知。

title.en: StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception
title.zh: StereoPolicy: Improving Robotic Manipulation Policies via Stereo Perception

note.en: Shows that stereo perception recovers the depth information monocular policies lack and improves robotic manipulation.
note.zh: 论文表明立体视觉能补上单目策略缺失的深度信息，从而提升机器人操作性能。

title.en: HumanScore: Benchmarking Human Motions in Generated Videos
title.zh: HumanScore: Benchmarking Human Motions in Generated Videos

note.en: HumanScore is a benchmark that systematically measures how realistic human motion is in generated video.
note.zh: HumanScore 是一个系统评测生成视频中人体动作真实度的基准。

title.en: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
title.zh: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL

note.en: Follow-up to the RAGEN line she co-authored, analysing why reasoning collapses during multi-turn agentic RL training.
note.zh: 她此前参与的 RAGEN 工作的续作，分析多轮智能体强化学习训练中推理能力崩溃的原因。

title.en: Making improvements one step at a time for Marble. In the case of generating bigger worlds, it's quite literal ;) 🤩🌐
title.zh: Making improvements one step at a time for Marble. In the case of generating bigger worlds, it's quite literal ;) 🤩🌐

note.en: Li shared a Marble product update on generating larger, more detailed AI worlds.
note.zh: 李飞飞分享了Marble产品更新，聚焦生成更大更精细的AI世界。

title.en: It’s 11th year and counting! Teaching the first lecture of @cs231n every year has been a highlight of my spring seasons. As usual, I asked students which depart
title.zh: It’s 11th year and counting! Teaching the first lecture of @cs231n every year has been a highlight of my spring seasons. As usual, I asked students which depart

note.en: Li marked the 11th year of teaching the opening lecture of Stanford's CS231n course.
note.zh: 李飞飞纪念了她讲授斯坦福CS231n课程开课讲座的第11个年头。

title.en: AI can generate 100 million splats, but it’s one creator’s imagination that made this uniquely beautiful world possible!🤩
title.zh: AI can generate 100 million splats, but it’s one creator’s imagination that made this uniquely beautiful world possible!🤩

note.en: Li argued that even as AI can generate massive 3D scenes, it's a creator's imagination that makes a world genuinely compelling.
note.zh: 李飞飞指出，尽管AI能生成海量3D场景，但真正让世界独具魅力的是创作者的想象力。

title.en: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
title.zh: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation

note.en: CaP-X benchmarks and improves code-generating agents used as controllers for robot manipulation.
note.zh: CaP-X 用于评测并改进以代码生成方式充当机器人操作控制器的智能体。

title.en: MIRAGE: The Illusion of Visual Understanding
title.zh: MIRAGE: The Illusion of Visual Understanding

note.en: Examines the mechanisms behind visual-language reasoning and argues much apparent visual understanding is illusory.
note.zh: 研究视觉语言推理的内在机制，指出多模态模型的“视觉理解”很大程度上是假象。

title.en: Our recent work using object-centered spatial information for better generalization 🦾
title.zh: Our recent work using object-centered spatial information for better generalization 🦾

note.en: Li highlighted new research using object-centered spatial information to improve model generalization.
note.zh: 李飞飞介绍了一项利用以物体为中心的空间信息来提升模型泛化能力的新研究。

title.en: Rapid Adaptation of Particle Dynamics for Generalized Deformable Object Mobile Manipulation
title.zh: Rapid Adaptation of Particle Dynamics for Generalized Deformable Object Mobile Manipulation

note.en: Learns to adapt particle-based dynamics models on the fly for mobile manipulation of deformable objects with unknown physics.
note.zh: 提出在线自适应粒子动力学模型的方法，用于物性未知的可变形物体的移动操作。

title.en: Love this essay from World Labs’ team! Just like codes, 3D is a universal interface for machines and people.🤩
title.zh: Love this essay from World Labs’ team! Just like codes, 3D is a universal interface for machines and people.🤩

note.en: Li praised a World Labs team essay arguing that 3D, like code, is becoming a universal interface for machines and people.
note.zh: 李飞飞称赞World Labs团队的一篇文章，主张3D如同代码一样正成为机器与人类的通用接口。

title.en: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs
title.zh: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs

note.en: Gives embodied LLM agents a reflective test-time planning loop so failed attempts inform later trials instead of repeating.
note.zh: 为具身大模型智能体加入反思式测试时规划，使失败经验能被吸收而不是反复重演。
